title: Bark+
description: Put bark back on, or collect it
body:
![BarkPlus title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4dcef294ff4ac4caf8b4eec8f0d8b148cb9e23dc.png)

Have you ever felt it? The builder's regret. That single, sinking moment when your axe swings just one time too many, and the perfect log in your masterpiece is stripped bare. An irreversible scar, a permanent imperfection that whispers of what could have been. You could break the block, journey back into the wilderness, and find another tree... or you could change the very rules of woodcraft itself.

Welcome to a mod that puts the power of restoration back into your hands. No longer is the act of stripping a log a final, binding decision. With this tool, you command the very essence of the wood, allowing you to mend, create, and perfect your builds with unparalleled control.

The Art of Mending Wood
This mod introduces a simple yet revolutionary concept: the ability to reclaim and re-apply bark to any stripped log. The forest itself provides the solution in the most intuitive way possible.

How It Works:

Reclaim the Bark: The solution is elegant and direct. Simply stripping a log or wood block with your axe will now cause a piece of its corresponding "Bark" to drop right at your feet. No crafting needed—the act of stripping provides the very tool for restoration.

Approach the Scar: Take this freshly acquired Bark in hand and approach any stripped log or stripped wood block that matches its type.

Restore the Grain: With a simple right-click, witness the magic. The bark seamlessly reapplies itself to the wood, restoring the block to its original, pristine state as if the axe had never touched it. The imperfection is gone, healed by your own hand.

Unleash Your Creative Freedom
This is more than just a tool for fixing mistakes; it is a key that unlocks a new realm of architectural possibility. For the meticulous builder, the creative designer, and the humble woodsman alike, this mod offers:

Flawless Construction: Build with confidence, knowing that any misplaced strip can be instantly corrected without dismantling your work. Your focus can remain on the grand design, not the fear of small errors.

Intricate Patterns & Texturing: Imagine the possibilities! Create stunning checkerboard patterns, spiraling pillars of alternating textures, or subtle gradients on your walls and floors. You can now use stripped logs as a temporary canvas, applying and removing bark to achieve the perfect aesthetic.

Resourceful Forestry: Conserve your resources and respect the environment. Instead of felling another tree to replace a single misplaced block, you can now mend the wood you already have. It’s a smarter, more efficient way to build.

Total Aesthetic Control: Your vision should never be compromised. This mod ensures that you have the final say on every single block, allowing for a level of detail and perfection that was previously impossible.

This is the ultimate tool for anyone who has ever looked at a wooden build and wished for just a little more control. It's simple, intuitive, and feels like it has always belonged in the game.

Download now, and never again regret the swing of your axe. Reclaim the grain.
